title: A Methodology for Advanced Manufacturing Defect Detection through Self-Supervised Learning on X-ray Images
mechanism: SimSiam and SimMIM pretraining on 27,901 unlabelled industrial X-ray images before Faster R-CNN defect detection.
adaptation: Positive counter-evidence for greyscale industrial in-domain SSL (detection, not segmentation); cite with the dermoscopy and DINOv3-industrial papers when reporting the benchmark's SSL result.
evidence: R: domain-pretrained models consistently beat ImageNet init; CNNs better at low data, Swin with many labels.
